apps.localizedDescription:
tangoAW2:

Rollback netplay for Advance Wars 2: Black Hole Rising (GBA, USA).

A fork of Tango (mGBA, rollback, matchmaking) for Advance Wars 2. Both players run the real game in its own Versus mode; your ROM is never modified (changes are applied in memory). No game is included: you need your own dump of the USA cartridge.

Get it:

Download the latest build from.

changed is in each release's notes): Windows (.exe installer), macOS on Apple Silicon (.dmg, not signed: right-click the app and choose Open the first time), Linux (.AppImage), or iPhone and iPad (.ipa, iOS 16 or later: install it with AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly; it plays with on-screen buttons or a controller at 60 to 120 Hz, sideways fitted between the buttons or stretched (Settings > Graphics), and online with desktop players).

versions.localizedDescription:
tangoAW2 0.9.10: Conquest Run.

Added.

• Conquest Run is its own mode on the main menu, directly above GAUNTLET: nine maps in a row against a new CO each, and one loss ends the run.
• The nine maps: Sabre Range, Asphalt Maze, Switchback, Piston Dam, Hourglass Isle, Ruby Keys, Vision Bridge, Cube Keys and Mial's Hope. The enemy gets more funds and units on every map.
• After each of the first eight maps you pick a reward. The war chest grows from 8,000 to 25,500, and the free units build up to Megatank, Neotank and Bomber. Par is 72 days.

Changed.

• Conquest Run results start a new record table. Old 5-map results stay saved but are not shown, and a 5-map run saved halfway can't be continued.

Fixed.

• The GAUNTLET mission card's letters are evenly spaced again.
• An army that is not in the game no longer gets a hidden copy of the Silver Nova HQ.
• Several automated tests that reported failures while the game was behaving correctly.
